description: Portal-side endpoints are removed only by step P of a decommissioning, for a previous vault generation or a vault no longer VNet-based; the scan for apps gone without a decommissioning only warns.

patches.find: printf '##vso[task.logissue type=warning]%s\n' "$slug in $e: the app or environment is gone, but its portal-side endpoint in $portal_rg is still there; delete it by hand (infra/README.md)"
